decisions: User authorized V20 with sliding tops after rejecting tall print orientation.
Fixed pockets replace drawers. Sloped rails plus a releasable catch retain each lid.
Field, shared hinge axis, original piece dimensions and side hook retained.

resolved_geometry_failures.change: Enlarged lid button from 12x3 to 20x5.6 mm
resolved_geometry_failures.failure: At old 2.8 mm inward release, raised button intersected the rail during withdrawal by 19.6 mm3.
resolved_geometry_failures.fix: Increase release to 4.5 mm and move pockets to give the arm and loaded pieces clearance.

resolved_geometry_failures.failure: Front entry relief was 1.6 mm too narrow; root overlapped base by 15.36 mm3.
resolved_geometry_failures.fix: Widen only the front catch entry relief to X=12 mm.
